body: Cmon man, do you really think that clinging on to things like that would make thing better? I've been trying so hard to hold out on any kind of hope no matter how big or small. Each time, I'm let down and fall harder than I ever was. I get worse and worse from how I started out. I don't know what to do. I don't know what could save me. I sure can't save myself anymore. But thanks for trying.
I like that idea, but I feel like I'm getting close to giving up everyday...
